facts.statement: Free Realms' second birthday event ran from the start of the post until May 18; the game turned 2 years old on April 28.
facts.quote: On April 28th Free Realms ™ will be two years old!

article_summaries.title: 2nd Birthday Party For Free Realms
article_summaries.summary: Announces Free Realms' 2nd birthday party, running from the post date until May 18 (captured 2011-04-30; the post says 'Posted 1 week, 1 day ago', so the date is inferred and approximate). Covers party areas, Speak-to-Camellia quest hub in Sanctuary, Cakenstein battle, birthday rewards, and Marketplace cakes, crates and pets.
